   1 extends "res://scripts/ui/title_screen.gd"
   2 
   3 const ROOM_NAMES: Dictionary = {"grand_lobby": "大厅", "card_banquet_gallery": "卡牌宴会长廊", "roulette_clocktower": "轮盘钟楼", "quiet_save_room": "静谧存档室", "house_throne": "庄家王座"}
   4 const POSITIONS: Dictionary = {"grand_lobby": Vector2(40, 165), "card_banquet_gallery": Vector2(340, 165), "roulette_clocktower": Vector2(640, 165), "quiet_save_room": Vector2(40, 35), "house_throne": Vector2(340, 35)}
   5 const CONNECTIONS: Array = [["grand_lobby", "card_banquet_gallery"], ["card_banquet_gallery", "roulette_clocktower"], ["grand_lobby", "quiet_save_room"], ["quiet_save_room", "house_throne"]]
   6 var diagram: Control
   7 var room_boxes: Dictionary = {}
   8 var connectors: Array[Dictionary] = []
   9 
  10 func _ready() -> void:
  11 	var content := build_modal("已探索地图", "仅显示你亲自到访的房间", false, 980)
  12 	diagram = Control.new()
  13 	diagram.name = "DiscoveredRooms"
  14 	diagram.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(920, 290)
  15 	diagram.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
  16 	content.add_child(diagram)
  17 	for pair in CONNECTIONS:
  18 		var line := Line2D.new()
  19 		line.width = 3.0
  20 		line.default_color = Color(0.63, 0.47, 0.31)
  21 		line.add_point(POSITIONS[pair[0]] + Vector2(110, 44))
  22 		line.add_point(POSITIONS[pair[1]] + Vector2(110, 44))
  23 		diagram.add_child(line)
  24 		connectors.append({"rooms": pair, "node": line})
  25 	for room_id in ROOM_NAMES:
  26 		var panel := PanelContainer.new()
  27 		panel.name = room_id
  28 		panel.position = POSITIONS[room_id]
  29 		panel.size = Vector2(220, 88)
  30 		diagram.add_child(panel)
  31 		var label := add_label(panel, ROOM_NAMES[room_id], 22)
  32 		label.name = "RoomLabel"
  33 		room_boxes[room_id] = panel
  34 	add_button(content, "返回游戏", "resume", "CloseButton")
  35 	add_label(content, "M / Esc 关闭 · 地图不能传送", 22)
  36 
  37 func refresh(snapshot: Dictionary) -> void:
  38 	var visited: Array = snapshot.get("visited_rooms", [])
  39 	for room_id in room_boxes:
  40 		var panel: PanelContainer = room_boxes[room_id]
  41 		panel.visible = room_id in visited
  42 		var current: bool = room_id == snapshot.get("room_id", "")
  43 		var label: Label = panel.get_node("RoomLabel")
  44 		label.text = ROOM_NAMES[room_id] + ("\n当前位置" if current else "")
  45 		label.add_theme_color_override("font_color", Color(1.0, 0.84, 0.45) if current else Color(0.86, 0.80, 0.94))
  46 	for connector in connectors:
  47 		connector.node.visible = connector.rooms[0] in visited and connector.rooms[1] in visited
